name: 40484 · Stanford, KY
findings: ZIP 40484 (Stanford) has 32 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 7 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 40484 (Stanford) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
57% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
